title: Roadside Cover and Out-of-Region Trips under the Keyturn Shield Host Plans
content:
Two things travel with the plan rather than with the vehicle under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan: whether roadside assistance comes with the plan and how many callouts it includes in a plan year, and how long a trip may run outside the enrolment's territory and stay covered.

| Plan | Roadside assistance included | Roadside callouts included in a plan year | Out-of-region trip cover, consecutive days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | no | 0 | 3 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | yes | 1 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | yes | 2 | 7 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | yes | 3 | 10 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | yes | 4 | 14 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | yes | 6 | 21 |

### Reading the columns

Roadside assistance comes with every plan except the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan, which includes none and publishes an allowance of 0 callouts. The included allowance rises with the depth of the cover, 1 callout on the Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan and 6 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan. Out-of-region cover runs from 3 consecutive days on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan to 21 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan.

### Basis question

Asked how long a protected vehicle may be taken outside the territory the enrolment is written for and remain covered, the answer is the number of consecutive days published for that plan, read from the last column and from nothing else.
